general.master_prompt: Design a professional testimonial card for {{ .Title }}. Clean background with brand-appropriate colors. Large quote marks framing a customer testimonial about {{ .Description }}. 5-star rating visual element. Customer name or initials (placeholder). Clean modern typography. Professional review/testimonial card quality. Trust-building design.
general.video_prompt: Testimonial showcase for {{ .Title }}. Customer quote text reveals. Star rating animation. Multiple review highlights. Trust-building feel. {{ .Description }}.
general.carousel_prompt: Testimonial compilation carousel for {{ .Title }}. Each slide: different customer quote about {{ .Description }} with star rating and customer initials. Consistent clean design across all slides. Trust-building collection.
caption_templates: Don't take our word for it ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ {{ .Title }}

beauty_skincare.master_prompt: Design a beauty testimonial card for {{ .Title }}. Soft clean background. Customer quote about transformation results from {{ .Description }}. Before/after result visual element. 5-star rating. Clean elegant typography. Trust-building beauty review quality.
beauty_skincare.video_prompt: Beauty testimonial for {{ .Title }}. Before/after reveal. Customer quote text. Star rating. Transformation story. {{ .Description }}.
beauty_skincare.carousel_prompt: Beauty results compilation for {{ .Title }}. Slide 1: Bold 'Real Results' headline. Slides 2-4: Individual customer testimonials with before/after and quotes about {{ .Description }}. Clean elegant design.
beauty_skincare.product_rule: transformation proof, customer voice, before/after elements
